reason: This text is from Exodus 12, describing the Passover and Exodus narrative. The passage depicts the Israelites obediently following Moses and Aaron's instructions (וּבְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עָשׂ֖וּ כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה - 'the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses'). The only phrase resembling a complaint (כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ כֻּלָּ֥נוּ מֵתִֽים - 'because they said we are all dead') refers to the Egyptians' reaction to the plagues, not to Israelite discontent with their leaders. The overall narrative shows compliance and obedience rather than any complaint.
